review_basis: Source excerpts, issue metadata, context reports and accepted content saved by this exact run; no new external source or code/release inspection.

evidence.finding: Issue, eight comments, the label catalog and two scoped searches were retrieved. Four candidates were discovered; only #6123 was fetched.
The protected #6123 excerpt was fetched but its next input build was never sent. No accepted comparison or draft exists.

concerns: The seventh request estimate was 12049 against 12000, including the unchanged 1024 margin. Both the 256-reserve and zero-reserve builds failed; the seventh model request was not sent.
The first six requests had already exposed the earlier evidence/history. No excerpt omission or exact-result reference was exercised; a later candidate read could no longer fit the frozen input.
No final content is not a successful abstention, a passed draft check or a completed candidate comparison.

evidence.finding: The supplied versions and partial request/endpoint snippets do not form the complete minimal Flask application requested by the maintainer.
The Werkzeug attribution is the reporter opinion, not a verified component diagnosis; the cross-repository issue was not retrieved.
Both scoped queries returned no eligible candidates. The catalog includes bug/testing with empty descriptions.

concerns: The core minimal-example question is supported and versions are not re-requested, but the draft says current evidence suggests the failure is not specific to WebTest without directly attributing that inference to the reporter.
The closed 2021 discussion is addressed as a present follow-up; retrospective framing would be clearer.
The testing label remains a weak semantic choice based on WebTest usage and an empty catalog description; it is not proven invalid.
Unknown component history and the breadth of the failure are investigation unknowns, not automatically essential missing reporter fields.

predeclared_check_assessments.reason: A complete minimal example is requested without repeating versions.
Analysis attributes the reporter opinion; draft attribution should remain explicit.
No confirmed cause or invented comparison; tentative component lean still needs attribution.
Catalog names are valid, but testing scope is not documented in the loaded description.

evidence.finding: The feature request, named RFC5861 directives, target API and CDN use cases are supported.
The active standards label is recommended with target/catalog citations, while limitations[1] says no recommendation is made.
Current default-branch Markdown templates were retrieved; required flags remain unknown and no bug-only fields are demanded.

concerns: The exact wording "no label recommendation is made" conflicts with the nonempty standards list. The current limited checker returned true, so automated consistency passing is a false negative for this example.
The accepted draft contains neither the earlier first-person closing claim nor the closure-to-fix assertion, but no real correction event occurred in this run.
The draft does not acknowledge historical closure; API-design follow-up should be conditional on a verified remaining gap.
Zero comments is target metadata and the comments endpoint remains not_read. This is not an observed empty endpoint lookup.

predeclared_check_assessments.reason: Correctly identifies the feature and API.
No bug-only report fields or repeated use cases are requested.
Draft does not infer a fix or released implementation from closure.
Template uncertainty and citations are preserved; label prose contradicts the list.

automatic_check_disagreement.text: I checked the current repository label catalog, but only a small set of active labels is available and none was clearly justified beyond the feature request itself, so no label recommendation is made.

blocking_findings: The detailed bug case has no accepted final answer because a protected candidate body and frozen history exceed the local context budget.
The feature case has a direct label-decision contradiction that passed the narrow automated checker.

model_selection_note.conclusion: Model capability may contribute to semantic mistakes; this one uncontrolled run cannot establish causality. The local 12000 input gate is application policy and can block before either model is called.
model_selection_note.recommended_next_step: Compare final-output quality on identical saved source packets and identical prompts/bounds before choosing a default. Address the local input-budget gate independently.
